title: Carolyn Kidd
body:
Flagstaff Unified School Board Member

Kidd was [endorsed](https://web.archive.org/web/20260929144406/https://www.arizonalist.org/elected-officials/carolyn-kidd/) by [Arizona List](https://web.archive.org/web/20260929143138/https://www.arizonalist.org/about-us/mission-vision/), a women’s group with the purpose of electing pro-abortion Democratic women.
